territorial_scope.description: Applies to systems deployed by the City of San José and to users acting for the City, including third-party vendors operating AI on the City's behalf.

evidence.quote: All systems deployed by the City

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: City of San José internal policy governing how City departments and their staff, contractors and vendors purchase, develop, use and maintain AI systems. It sets guiding principles, AI risk review, vendor disclosure duties, prohibited AI uses, 24-hour harm reporting and sunset procedures.
summary.long: The City of San José's internal AI Policy governs how City departments purchase, configure, develop, operate and maintain AI systems. It applies to all systems the City deploys and to staff, interns, consultants, contractors, partners and volunteers acting as users. It sets eight guiding principles (effectiveness, transparency, equity, accountability, human-centered design, privacy, security and safety, workforce empowerment) and requires users to uphold them, conduct an AI Review of potential risk, and follow the AI Incident Response Plan. The CIO designates a City Information Security Officer and a City Digital Privacy Officer. Finance must require vendors to disclose AI use and provide technical documentation, including an AI Fact Sheet, and procurement solicitations must ask about AI use. Prohibited uses include real-time and covert biometric identification, emotion analysis, fully automated decisions substantially affecting rights or safety without meaningful human oversight, social scoring and cognitive behavioral manipulation. Staff must report AI-caused harm within 24 hours of discovery. Systems that cease to provide a positive outcome must be halted unless the CIO grants an exception; disruptive systems follow a CIO-approved phased shutdown. Violations may result in discipline, breach-of-contract remedies or damages. Detailed requirements sit in the AI Handbook, which is referenced but not included in the text provided.
